name: Dock
description: A macOS-style dock of icon buttons with hover tooltips, accessible names, and an active-app indicator dot.
usage:
<Dock>
  <DockItem active icon={<Mail />} label="Mail" />
  <DockItem icon={<Music />} label="Music" />
  <DockItem icon={<Folder />} label="Files" />
</Dock>

anatomy.description: Centered icon bar rendered as a named navigation landmark.
Icon buttons whose label is both the accessible name and the tooltip text.
Non-interactive indicator under the current app.

dos: Keep the set small; every icon must stay recognizable.
Give the dock a distinct aria-label when other nav landmarks share the page.
donts: Don't use it when items need visible text labels; use Bottom Nav.
Don't overload it with destinations; it is a launcher, not a full nav.

examples.title: App dock
examples.description: Icon buttons lift on hover and show a tooltip label; active apps get a dot underneath.

examples.title: Custom landmark name
examples.description: A custom aria-label scopes the dock when several navigation landmarks share the page.

guidance.useWhen: A small set of apps or tools should be launchable from a playful, icon-only bar, such as in a desktop-like workspace.
guidance.avoidWhen: Items need visible text labels or there are more than a handful of destinations; use BottomNav or VerticalNav instead.
guidance.behavior: Every item is a real button whose label prop is both the accessible name and the tooltip text; active adds a non-interactive indicator dot.
guidance.responsive: The dock sizes to its icons and centers in available space; on narrow screens keep the item count low or allow horizontal scrolling in a wrapper.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the icon buttons.

notes: Renders a navigation landmark labelled "Dock" by default.
Each item's label becomes its aria-label, so icon-only buttons stay announced.
The tooltip and active dot are aria-hidden; state is never conveyed by color alone to assistive technology.

props.description: Accessible name for the dock landmark.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Shows a dot under the icon marking the running or current app.
props.name: active

props.description: Name of the item; used as the accessible name and the tooltip text.
props.name: label
